title: Level 2 (Intermediate) - D-3
notes:
West leads the ♥K against 6♠. West's heart opening lead is won in dummy with the ♥A. South will need trumps to break 3-2 in order for there to be a chance, but it would be a mistake for South to cash the ♠A and ♠K immediately.

South cannot afford to concede a trump trick to the defense at this point as the defense would be able to cash hearts to defeat the contract by 2 tricks. South can come close to making the contract on the above layout by starting the diamonds instead of conceding the third round of trump to the defense. East had to follow to the first 3 rounds of diamonds, but he is able to ruff the 4th round as South discards a heart. The defense will now take the setting trick in hearts.

South's mistake came at trick 2 when he won the first round of trump. If South had ducked the first round of trump to the defense he would have made his contract. If East returns a heart (no defense is better) South can take the ruff in dummy, cash the ♣A, and ruff a club in the closed hand. It is now safe to draw the rest of the trump. The dummy's diamonds will provide a parking place for South's remaining heart loser.
